# SKYi Developers Pune — Official Knowledge Base

> SKYi Developers (Enerrgia SKYi Developers) is Pune's premier real estate developer established in 2004. Over 20+ years, SKYi has delivered 7,000+ homes across 20+ landmark developments covering over 500+ acres with IGBC Platinum Green Certifications.

## Flagship Townships & Developments

- **Skyi Songbirds (Bhugaon, Paud Road)**: 45-acre master eco-township featuring 1, 2, 3 & 4 BHK hillside residences, 70% open green space, and the 5-acre Poona Western Club. Prices start at ₹38 Lakhs* for 1 BHK smart homes. MahaRERA: P52100000769, P52100001117, P52100019348, P52100047992.
  - URL: https://skyidevelopers.in/songbirds

- **SKYi Manas Lake (Bhukum, Paud Road)**: 90-acre lakeside township offering 2 & 3 BHK homes and PMRDA-sanctioned clear title NA bungalow plots directly on the waterfront. Prices start at ₹65 Lakhs* for residences, ₹95 Lakhs* for NA plots. MahaRERA: P52100000513, P52100000514, P52100026954, P52100052033.
  - URL: https://skyidevelopers.in/manas-lake

- **SKYi Manas Lake PMRDA NA Bungalow Plots (Bhukum)**: 100% clear title Collector NA sanction, individual 7/12 extracts, FSI 1.5 (G+2 allowable), plot sizes 2,000 to 5,000+ sq.ft., underground electricity, water, and sewage lines.
  - URL: https://skyidevelopers.in/na-plots-bhukum

- **SKYi Tigers Nest (Bhugaon Foothills)**: Ultra-luxury hillside villas and 3 & 4 BHK residences starting at ₹1.79 Cr*.
- **SKYi Five Racecourse (Sopan Baug)**: Exclusive luxury sky mansions starting at ₹3.85 Cr*.
- **SKYi Five Maidan (Baner)**: 4 BHK premium residences starting at ₹2.45 Cr*.
- **SKYi Star City (Dhayari, Sinhagad Road)**: 20-acre delivered township with 1 & 2 BHK homes starting at ₹42 Lakhs*.

## Key Locations & Connectivity
- **Bhugaon & Bhukum Corridor**: Paud Road 6-lane expressway connecting Chandani Chowk and Kothrud (6-10 minutes drive). Close to Pune Ring Road and Hinjewadi IT Park.
- **Micro-Locations Covered**: Bhugaon, Bhukum, Bavdhan, Pirangut, Lavale, Manas Lake, Chandani Chowk, Kothrud, Baner, Sopan Baug.
